move: swatches grow up in sequence, lift in a wave, drop out reversed
how: A white card carrying a title and six colour swatches rises in with expo.out. From 10% each swatch scales from scaleY 0 (transform-origin bottom, expo.out, 0.12s stagger) while its fill layer grows from scaleY .4 for a soft overshoot look; labels slide up and a small chip pops with back.out(3). At 52% a lift wave runs across the row (y -14, 0.06s stagger) and settles with elastic.out. At 82% the swatches collapse to scaleY 0 from the last one backwards (power3.in) and the card fades down.
adapt: Replace the palette name, swatch names, hex labels and fill colours; add or remove swatches freely (stagger scales); keep the scaleY entry with bottom origin and the reversed collapse.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the card from shot.swatches; animate returns the timeline with entries at 0.1D, the wave at 0.52D and the exit at 0.82D. Direct port; scope .sw/.fill/.lbl to el.
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false when reused in a larger timeline
